messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — need to finalize the tutorial sprint priorities for next week's launch. Focus: simple refapp + 3 short tutorials, plus a webinar. Thoughts?

tara: +1 on refapp-first. Can we slot the latency/cost micro-benchmark into the refapp README? That's the key narrative.

jonah: Agree. Suggest order: 1) Quickstart (10m), 2) Building with Redwood API (20m), 3) Adding Dedicated/Private config (15m).

lucy: For the launch post, let's lead with "developer productivity" not "infrastructure". Messaging iteration: A/B test two intros — "ship faster with predictable inference" vs "cut token costs with smart batching".

devrel-bot: created task #PRJ-421: tutorial sprint content + benchmark writeups — assigned to @morgan and @jonah :spiral_note_pad:

morgan: Thanks — @tara can you own the benchmark narrative? Keep it <300 words, include a 1-line TL;DR and a 2-row table for results.

tara: Yup. I'll draft and paste in #marketing-drafts by EOD. Quick Q: inbound lead routing — webinar signups should flow into SFDC campaign "DevTutorials-March" or keep separate?

jonah: Put them into the "DevTutorials-March" campaign and tag source=webinar, content=refapp-tutorials. We'll route hot leads to AE queue via Zapier.

lucy: Webinar plan: 30 mins demo + 15 mins Q&A. Use a short pre-webinar survey to capture use case and infra (hosted/dedicated/private).

morgan: Good. Also add a "try it now" CTA linking to the refapp repo + 1-click deploy template. I'll mock the deploy button.

tara: Drafting messaging A/B copy now. will loop in design for hero image :eyes: 

jonah: FYI — bench numbers: on 8xA100, latency 45ms per token @batch-32, cost ~0.002/token. I'll attach the raw CSV to the ticket.

lucy: Great. If we keep the launch timeline tight, publish post + webinar next Thursday, tutorial PRs merged by Tue.

morgan: Sounds good. Action items: tara (benchmark draft), jonah (bench CSV + deploy template), lucy (launch copy + A/B variants), me (refapp README + deploy button). Ping if blocked.

tara: on it :muscle:

devrel-bot: reminder: sprint doc updated — https://docs.internal/redwood/dev-tutorials-sprint

morgan: I'll drop the first draft into #marketing-drafts in ~4h.
